# 259_R6FIX.10 — BL-111: `u6-stub-turn.fixture.json` never emitted to dist

Fixes the scheduled `journeys.yml` nightly red since ~2026-11-06 (run 43034547961, root
cause by 206_R6REC.3 → BL-111): `r7legs.ts`'s `U6_CHAT` reads the stub-turn fixture as a
`src/` sibling via `import.meta.url`, but `tsc -b` emits only TypeScript outputs — the
emitted `dist/r7legs.js` resolved `dist/u6-stub-turn.fixture.json`, a file the build never
writes → ENOENT in the dist leg. A committed harness defect — not provenance, not a product
leg. Base `main`. **mergePolicy: OPERATOR** — the operator merges; a run never merges itself.

## Fix — the package's own `fixtures/` pattern

Every other non-TS leg asset already lives in `packages/journeys/fixtures/` and is read one
level up from the module (`steps.ts`, `provision-res1.ts`) — `src/../fixtures` and
`dist/../fixtures` resolve to the same committed file, so `tsc -b` never has to emit it.

- `packages/journeys/src/u6-stub-turn.fixture.json` → `packages/journeys/fixtures/`
  (byte-identical — the leg's stub input is not weakened).
- `r7legs.ts` — exported `U6_STUB_TURN_FIXTURE` (`dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))` +
  `../fixtures/…`); `U6_CHAT` reads it. Leg body otherwise unchanged.
- `packages/journeys/src/u6-fixture.test.ts` — pins the exported path resolves, lands in
  package-root `fixtures/` (never `dist/`), and parses to the leg's stub input shape.
